notes.title: New patch available to fix a major issue + improvements
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/a6b9fa5ac5b2e226d0c9e5308f7b708a40c86fb3.png

We have released Stories of Bethem: Full Moon v1.3.2 for Windows, Ubuntu and OS X. It contains a fix for an important error that only happens starting your game in v1.3.0, minor bug fixing and a couple of minor improvements and adjustments.

One of these improvements is the new recycling screen: we can choose how many items we want to introduce in the machines now. Take a look at the following screenshot!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/40afd7344c351945ff69096094bdcaff82b880fa.png

We also made easier that some monsters drop their aura.

The major issue
After talking to the Red Witch for the first time, you shouldn't be able to go to the West area. There, an event will be triggered and the game line will go a little crazy. If you save the game after this, your game will be altered forever.

When you get the first Oneiric Object in the Warehouse, you won't be able to know what the Red Witch was to tell you. She is just angry and you'll never know why.

What can I expect if this happened to me?
Don't worry! The game should works fine if you complete the first dungeon before the second.

You'll have got too many gems to ruin your trades (and a part of your game, because finding gems makes no sense then). 

Can I fix it?
You can send us your saved game at our support e-mail and we'll cast a new spell on your gems if you want. If you haven't got the first Oneiric Object yet and you went to the West area, consider as a choice starting.

Don't hesitate to contact us if you want us to destroy your gems :P

Why?
We tried to make the game opening faster for the player, so we removed a couple of irrelevant scenes with the last update. We forgot to cast the anti-bug spell and the terrible bug was born ːredcriesː

More info: http://support.gugames-dev.com/en/stories-of-bethem-full-moon#topic1

Our apologies
We are so sorry for this. Don't hesitate to contact us if you want to "fix" your gems.

Thanks to Yannick and Fancore for the bug discovery and helping us to fix it.

notes.title: Small update + cross-platform Steam Cloud!
notes.notes:
We released a small update for Stories of Bethem: Full Moon and its demo version. In addition, you are able to continue your game from different platforms if you have Steam Cloud enabled now because saved files are synchronized between platforms too.

Explore, solve puzzles and have fun wherever you want!

List of improvements:
 Bug fixing.
 Costume price adjustment.
 Saving directories are now lowercase.
 New logo of GuGames Development shown when loading.
 New streetlights.
 Graphical optimization.


Check the fixed bugs at the GuGames Bux Box.

We also updated the game trailer to add the costumes and improve some elements.

Thanks for your attention. Have fun!

notes.title: The new update that includes WASD mode is now available
notes.notes:
The new update (v1.1.6) fixes some bugs and improves the compatibility with some devices. But the main new features are the WASD keyboard mode and the Steam overlay now fixed on Mac OS X.

How to change the keyboard mode
Change the keyboard mode on the Config option of the main screen. You must disconnect the gamepad to enable the mode changing.

Note: We found a new bug if you play using WASD with a gamepad connected. Disconnect your gamepad if you play with the keyboard. It will be fixed in the next update.

What's next?
We're working to include Steam Trading Cards as soon as possible. A new hidden dungeon will be available in the game when they are ready too. Stay tuned!

notes.title: There is Full Moon today: SOBFM update
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

Did you look at the sky today: it's Full Moon. What does that mean?

We're happy to announce that the SOBFM update that includes the English revision is now available.

But we are working on porting the game for Mac OSX and Ubuntu as soon as possible. Stay tuned!

Happy Holidays and happy Full Moon :)

Best regards.

notes.title: New small update for Stories of Bethem: Full Moon
notes.notes:
Hello friends.

We launch another update to fix an asset compiler error that missed some audio files of the game.

Sorry for the inconvenience.

Now we'll update the game less frequently. Advance: The next update will include a big English text revision to improve the grammar!

Thank you for playing. Best regards.

notes.title: Stories of Bethem: Full Moon update available (v1.0.1)
notes.notes:
The new game version fixes the bugs reported by users in level 5, monster collision errors and minor improvements.

We also included 2 new achievements, there are 48 finally. Let's get them all!

Now, you can share screenshots of the game with the SOBFM community by pressinf F12. We are waiting for them :)

You can also press:

     F1: Open the game group.
     F2: Check the achievement list.
     F3: Open your steam activity page to post anything you want in-game.


Enjoy the update!
